audit_findings.title: FY2021 does not represent the current leveraged common-equity claim
audit_findings.magnitude: FY2021 OE was $178.3m, $104.8m above FY2025 OE; the $500m notes carry a computed $32.5m annual coupon before tax, versus issuance on October 7, 2021
audit_findings.mechanism: The non-comparable FY2021 observation enters the five-year log trend used to set the $57.6m OE anchor. An overstated early observation steepens the fitted decline and depresses the current anchor.
audit_findings.evidence: On October 7, 2021, Consensus issued $500 million of 6.5% senior notes due in 2028 (the “2028 Senior Notes”), in a private placement offering exempt from the registration requirements of the Securities Act of 1933.
audit_findings.explanation: The timing mismatch is demonstrated: most of FY2021 preceded the present notes and post-separation cost structure. The correct comparable FY2021 OE and resulting valuation change remain unresolved, but the observation is the largest in the series and directly determines the anchor, making the issue reasonably capable of changing the valuation conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Reconstruct FY2021 with a full year of contractual interest, taxes, standalone costs and capital requirements; rerun the log-trend anchor, all scenarios and the buy-below price without changing other assumptions.

audit_findings.title: Unbounded separation liabilities may sit ahead of common equity
audit_findings.mechanism: Any probable nonrecurring payment not already accrued would reduce the equity bridge; recurring separation-related costs would instead reduce OE.
audit_findings.evidence: For example, we continue to have indemnification obligations to Ziff Davis for matters including liabilities primarily associated with the Consensus business and we continue to be severally liable for certain Ziff Davis tax obligations.
audit_findings.explanation: The continuing indemnification and several-liability obligations are demonstrated, but no claim, maximum exposure, probability or net amount after reciprocal Ziff Davis indemnities is supplied. The record therefore cannot establish whether the omitted exposure is material.
audit_findings.action: Review the separation and tax-matters agreements, subsequent claims and legal correspondence; identify caps, triggers, offsets, accruals and expected payments, then rerun the bridge for any probable unrecorded net obligation.

audit_findings.title: The equity bridge appears to omit a booked uncertain-tax claim
audit_findings.magnitude: $15.279m at June 30, 2026, equal to $0.71 per diluted share and 1.66% of the $918m base equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: A cash settlement of a previously expensed tax liability would reduce bridge cash without reducing projected OE again.
audit_findings.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, we had outstanding $562.2 million in aggregate principal amount of indebtedness (of which $7.5 million is payable within the next 12 months), total minimum lease payments of $14.4 million and a liability for uncertain tax positions of $14.5 million (see Note 7 - Long-Term Debt, Note 8 - Leases and Note 11 - Income Taxes of the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements in Part II, Item 8 of this Form 10-K, respectively).
audit_findings.explanation: The booked liability and its omission from the stated bridge are demonstrated, although the payment amount and timing are uncertain. Deducting the entire latest liability would reduce base value from $42.78 to about $42.07 per share and bear value from $37.00 to about $36.29, both still above the $35.36 price; it would not reverse the conclusion that the price remains above the $29.95 buy-below threshold.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile the $15.279m liability to expected settlements, reversals and timing; deduct only the expected nonrecurring cash payment unless it is already included in projected OE.

audit_findings.title: Debt-extinguishment gains may contaminate the owner-earnings trend
audit_findings.magnitude: Pretax Debt Repurchase Program effects were a $4.8m gain in 2023, $6.6m gain in 2024 and $0.1m loss in 2025; the gains equal 7.7% and 9.8% of reported OE for 2023 and 2024
audit_findings.mechanism: Because interest expense is retained, unnormalized extinguishment gains increase annual OE observations and the log-trend anchor; removing the small 2025 loss would have the opposite effect.
audit_findings.evidence: For years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023 a (loss) gain on debt extinguishment of $( 0.1 ) million, $ 6.6 million and $ 4.8 million, respectively, related to the Debt Repurchase Program is included in interest expense on the Consolidated Statements of Income.
audit_findings.explanation: The nonrecurring amounts inside filed interest expense are demonstrated. Whether the OE reconciliations already normalized them is unresolved. Their scale relative to the two middle trend observations is sufficient to move the anchor materially, particularly because the bear value is only $1.64 per share above market price.
audit_findings.action: Inspect the annual OE reconciliations, remove each after-tax extinguishment gain or loss while retaining contractual interest, and rerun the anchor, scenarios and buy-below price.

audit_findings.title: Gross cash may not equal distributable cash for common shareholders
audit_findings.magnitude: $74.2m of the $98.9m June 30, 2026 cash balance was foreign; this location-exposed amount equals $3.46 per diluted share
audit_findings.mechanism: Taxes, transfer restrictions or minimum operating cash would reduce the cash added one-for-one in the equity bridge.
audit_findings.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, cash and cash equivalents held within domestic and foreign jurisdictions were $8.9 million and $65.8 million, respectively.
audit_findings.explanation: Foreign concentration is demonstrated, while actual leakage is not. The potential scale is material: removing the full $74.2m location-exposed amount would reduce bear value from $37.00 to about $33.54 per share, below the $35.36 market price, so the unresolved availability question is reasonably capable of changing the valuation conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Obtain the June 30, 2026 cash-by-entity schedule, legal transfer restrictions, operating-cash requirements and incremental repatriation-tax calculation; rerun the bridge using only net distributable cash.

audit_findings.title: The added investment stakes may be carrying values rather than realizable values
audit_findings.magnitude: The bridge adds $9.5m, equal to $0.44 per diluted share and 1.03% of the $918m base equity value; June 30, 2026 ASC 321 investments carried at $15.0m
audit_findings.mechanism: A realizability discount or disposal costs reduce the stakes component of the bridge; related investment income could affect OE if not purged.
audit_findings.evidence: Equity securities without a readily determinable fair value, which are not accounted for under the equity method of accounting, are measured at their cost, less impairment, if any, and adjusted for observable price changes arising from orderly transactions in the same or similar investment from the same issuer.
audit_findings.explanation: The securities' measurement basis is demonstrated, but a realizability shortfall is not. Even writing the entire $9.5m bridge addition to zero would reduce base value only to about $42.34 and bear value to about $36.56 per share, leaving both above the $35.36 price. The 2026 unrealized gain also falls outside the 2021–2025 OE series.
audit_findings.action: Map the $9.5m adjustment to each security, document current transaction support, liquidity and disposal taxes, and confirm investment income was excluded; rerun only if the supported net value differs from $9.5m.

audit_findings.title: Unidentified D&A is conservatively left in owner earnings
audit_findings.magnitude: FY2021 identified eligible D&A was $39.7m, or 76.6% of filed D&A, implying approximately $12.1m remained unclassified; other years and valuation impact are unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: Eligible residual D&A would increase the affected annual OE observations. Because the valuation uses a declining log trend and the lower of trend and latest OE, adjustments concentrated in early versus recent years can move the anchor in different directions.
audit_findings.evidence: identified eligible D&A is below the filed composite; residual is conservatively left as an expense, not added back: FY2021 $39.7m (76.6% of filed D&A)
audit_findings.explanation: Leaving unidentified D&A as an expense is demonstrated and is conservative for each annual OE observation. The record does not classify the residual or provide corresponding amounts for every trend year, so it cannot establish the direction or materiality of the final valuation effect.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile filed D&A by year to tangible depreciation, capitalized-software amortization and acquired-intangible amortization; add back only components supported as non-economic, then rerun the log trend and scenarios.
